symptom: Changing only a gradient angle rewrote var(--token) colour stops as browser-resolved RGB literals, detaching the gradient from theme tokens.
rule: Edit round-trippable authored gradients rather than their computed paint, while keeping the resolved paint for display. Token-valued stops are not editable as ordinary colours until token stop authoring exists.
check: pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/design-workspace/__tests__/design-fill-destructive-edits.test.ts -t 'preserves var() gradient stops when only the angle changes'
